title: Roles with database access across multiple servers
description: For each role count the number of distinct servers hosting databases from its grants. Keep roles with access to at least two distinct servers. Return exactly two columns: role_name, server_count. Multiple grants to databases on the same server count that server only once. Sort by server_count DESC, then role_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT r.role_name
FROM role_grants AS g
hints: The chain is grants → roles and grants → databases → servers.
COUNT(DISTINCT server_id) prevents multiple databases on one server from inflating the count.
solution_explanation: COUNT DISTINCT across the joins measures infrastructure spread rather than raw grant count.
